title: Evidence v1
description: Evidence record linking an assertion or graph entity to a verifiable source artifact. Every fact in the EOIP knowledge graph should be traceable to at least one evidence record, establishing provenance from source system through parser to graph.

evidence_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence record.

source_system.description: Origin system where the evidence was captured (e.g. jira, gitlab, confluence, git, servicenow).

source_ref.description: URI or identifier within the source system pointing to the original artifact (e.g. issue URL, commit SHA, page ID).

captured_at.description: When this evidence was captured from the source system.

method.description: Extraction method used (e.g. api_poll, webhook, git_hook, file_watch, manual).

parser_version.description: Version of the parser that processed the raw source data.

mapper_version.description: Version of the mapper that normalized source data into graph entities.

confidence.description: Confidence that this evidence correctly supports the linked assertion. 1.0 = deterministic extraction.
